scope: Read-only Windows Installer database inspection of the retained official Wireshark 4.6.9 x64 MSI

artifact.inspectionMode: Windows Installer COM database opened read-only; no MSI action was run

launchConditions: The MSI states Wireshark 4.6.9 requires Windows 10 version 1809 or Windows Server 2019, or later.
Earlier Windows versions are rejected by separate launch conditions.
databaseFindings.runtimeComponents: The VCRedist feature maps AMD64 and ARM64 Visual C++ runtime components into System64Folder with architecture conditions. Exact feature selection and system runtime effects remain to be verified on disposable Windows targets.

assessment.Npcap: Not included in the MSI file table; live packet capture enrollment remains a separate interactive workflow.
assessment.Associations: The catalog disables Wireshark file-extension associations for its selected install.
assessment.HistoricalAcceptedSlice: The 2026-10-22 ApplicationsBatch1 evidence records clean-absence install, repeat, remove and saved-run recovery passing for Wireshark 4.6.9.0 on RIDE-Win11-Test (Windows 11 build 26300) and RIDE-S25-Test (Windows Server 2025 build 26100).
assessment.TargetSupport: No target is currently promoted. The recorded clean-absence lifecycle passes do not cover existing-install transitions, association/shared-runtime preservation or broader recovery; MSI launch conditions alone do not establish support.
assessment.MigrationOutcome: The clean-absence install/repeat/remove/recovery slice is accepted on the two recorded images. The whole legacy outcome remains partial until existing-installation, association/shared-runtime and broader recovery acceptance passes.
